description: This file contains the implementation of the EcuDefinition interface in Java. It defines the EcuDefinitionImpl class, which models an ECU (Engine Control Unit) definition with properties such as ecuId, calId, carString, inherits, and ecuDefFile. It provides public getter methods for these properties and validates some inputs during construction.
